Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical reasoning error by misidentifying the historical figure based on the search results. The WebSurfer correctly retrieved information about "Philip of Sicily" (1255–1277), who was the son of **Charles I of Sicily** (also known as Charles I of Naples). However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the target was "Philip I of Taranto" (1278–1331), whose father was Charles II. This is a hallucination or a failure to correctly map the retrieved data (Philip 1255-1277) to the correct parent (Charles I) instead of switching to a different historical figure (Philip 1278-1331) entirely. Consequently, the Planner provided the wrong answer (Charles II) instead of the correct one (Charles I).
